params.name: profileId
params.description: The profile ID (personal or business) associated with the 3DS challenge.

items.docs:
Once the customer has accepted or rejected the push notification for a 3DS challenge, you can use this endpoint to notify us of the result.

You must call this endpoint before the expiration time, otherwise it will return a 400 error. You can find the expiration information from the [3DS challenge webhook event](/guides/developer/webhooks/event-types#3ds-challenge).
